name: kachi
description: When a check you broke turns green after a real fix, the band above the prompt sweeps green once with a short click, and the result row keeps the score; silent the rest of the time but for one dim line on a check's first red

sound.title: Sound
sound.description: on, quiet (half the gain, no tick for a commit or a first green) or off

motion.title: Motion
motion.description: sweep, or none for the static stamp only (reduced motion)

minTier.title: Smallest win
minTier.description: Wins below this tier are ignored: tick (a clean commit or a first green, opt-in), click, chime, bell

commits.title: Commit tick
commits.description: A commit made on a tree verified after its last edit earns a tick

testPaths.title: Extra test paths
testPaths.description: Comma-separated globs that also count as test files, whose edits alone never earn a win (e.g. e2e/**,*.snap)
